against_offset_0.change: The cold plate (dev) with its face 0.27 mm higher on the same mesh (the controller's ruling T7-m; stage3_cases.py plate-cold --offset-mm 0.27): its skin base cuts its 0.7 mm cells as a 10 % sliver of metal (71 % at offset 0), and its slab holds 8.27 mm of metal instead of 8 mm. Judged by Task 7's criteria (the 8 mm references) it fails: 0.760, 2.628 and 5.037 mm at 1.0, 1.5 and 2.0 s, 3.7, 3.1 and 3.5 % behind REFERENCE_1D (within the 5 %) and 9.2, 5.2 and 4.9 % behind REFERENCE_1D_LIQUIDUS (past it at 1.0 and 1.5 s). The cause, measured: the deeper slab. analysis/ablation_1d.py for an 8.27 mm slab (1 um, 0.5 ms; scratch, once; the 8 mm runs reproduced both committed references exactly) gives references_for_8.27_mm; against them the plate is 0.7, 0.2 and -0.1 % from the first and 5.4, 2.1 and 1.6 % behind the second, where the offset-0 plate is 1.4, 0.2 and -0.3 % and 4.4, 1.9 and 1.8 % from its own. The mesh offset's own effect is thus at most 0.9 percentage points (at 1.0 s), less than one 20 um skin cell, 2.5 % of the 1.0 s recession (the plate recedes in whole cells: 0.760 mm is 38, 0.800 mm 40). Diagnosis D1's 5 % slower recession at this offset was the deeper slab.
